title: Advisory Producer Configuration
description: Default configuration for the advisory feed producer. Scheduled runs may override provider, feed, URL, and credential references per schedule.

provider.title: Default provider
provider.description: Default provider for manual command invocations.

feed_key.title: Default feed key
feed_key.description: Logical feed key recorded with emitted advisory batches.

url.title: Default feed URL
url.description: Provider API or JSON feed URL.

api_key.title: NVD API key
api_key.description: Optional NVD API key material. Prefer credential broker delivery for production use.

api_token.title: VulnCheck API token
api_token.description: Optional VulnCheck API token material. Prefer credential broker delivery for production use.
